# Introduction

Figure S4A: paired bagging Random Forest to identify cytokines that distinguish
pre-treatment (W0) from post-treatment visits (16, 24, and 72 weeks) in patients
with successful treatment outcome (n = 33). For each bootstrap
iteration, patients are sampled with replacement and both their visits are
included, preserving the paired structure. Importance scores are averaged across
all valid iterations.

Figure 2A: ROC curves with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the top
cytokines from each RF comparison.

# Load packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file       <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"
output_fig2a_s4a <- "Output/02. Figure_2A_S4A"

dir.create(output_fig2a_s4a, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
cytokine_cols <- c(
  "BDNF", "CCL11", "Factor_VII", "ICAM_1",
  "IL_1_alpha", "IL_1_beta", "IL_10", "IL_12p40",
  "IL_12p70", "IL_18", "IL_1RA", "IL_3", "IL_4",
  "IL_6", "IL_7", "IL_8", "CCL2", "CCL3",
  "MMP_3", "TNF", "VEGF", "IFNG", "IL_2",
  "pan_IFNA", "IFNB"
)
```
# Filter to successful treatment outcome

```{r}
protein_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Condition, all_of(cytokine_cols))
```

# Reshape to wide format

```{r}
protein_log_wide <- protein_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cytokine_cols),
    names_to  = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(combined_name = paste(Condition, Cytokine, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(-Condition, -Cytokine) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = combined_name,
    values_from = Value
  )
```

# Hyperparameter configuration
Each comparison has its own configuration and can be tuned independently to achieve the lowest error rate.

```{r}
rf_config <- list(

  W0_W16 = list(
    visits             = c("0", "16"),
    variance_threshold = 0.01,
    n_random           = 10,
    n_bags             = 100,
    ntree              = 600,
    k_folds            = 5,
    mtry_range         = NULL,
    n_bootstrap_roc    = 2000,
    top_n_cytokines    = 4
  ),

  W0_W24 = list(
    visits             = c("0", "24"),
    variance_threshold = 0.01,
    n_random           = 10,
    n_bags             = 100,
    ntree              = 600,
    k_folds            = 5,
    mtry_range         = NULL,
    n_bootstrap_roc    = 2000,
    top_n_cytokines    = 4
  ),

  W0_W72 = list(
    visits             = c("0", "72"),
    variance_threshold = 0.01,
    n_random           = 10,
    n_bags             = 100,
    ntree              = 600,
    k_folds            = 5,
    mtry_range         = NULL,
    n_bootstrap_roc    = 2000,
    top_n_cytokines    = 4
  )
)
```

# Helper functions

`prepare_rf_data`: filters to the visit pair, sets Visit as an ordered factor,
removes low-variance features, and adds random reference features drawn from
the same distribution as the cytokine values.

```{r}
prepare_rf_data <- function(wide_data, config) {
  visits             <- config$visits
  variance_threshold <- config$variance_threshold
  n_random           <- config$n_random

  data_filt <- wide_data %>%
    filter(Visit %in% visits) %>%
    mutate(Visit = factor(Visit, levels = visits))
  
    # Rename factor levels to valid R variable names for caret compatibility
  levels(data_filt$Visit) <- paste0("W", levels(data_filt$Visit))

  feature_cols <- setdiff(names(data_filt), c("ID1", "Visit"))
  variances    <- sapply(data_filt[, feature_cols], var, na.rm = TRUE)
  retained     <- names(variances[variances > variance_threshold])
  data_filt    <- data_filt[, c("ID1", "Visit", retained)]

  cyt_vals  <- unlist(data_filt[, retained], use.names = FALSE)
  rand_mean <- mean(cyt_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  rand_sd   <- sd(cyt_vals,   na.rm = TRUE)

  set.seed(123)
  random_cols <- paste0("Random_", seq_len(n_random))
  for (col in random_cols) {
    data_filt[[col]] <- rnorm(nrow(data_filt), mean = rand_mean, sd = rand_sd)
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    "Visits: %s | Rows: %d | Features retained: %d | Random added: %d\n",
    paste(visits, collapse = " vs "), nrow(data_filt),
    length(retained), n_random
  ))

  list(data = data_filt, retained = retained, random_cols = random_cols)
}
```

`tune_rf`: tunes `mtry` using patient-level grouped k-fold CV. All patients
are in the CV pool since there is no held-out test set.

```{r}
tune_rf <- function(prep, config) {
  data       <- prep$data
  k_folds    <- config$k_folds
  ntree      <- config$ntree
  mtry_range <- config$mtry_range

  patient_ids <- data$ID1
  data_train  <- data[, !names(data) %in% "ID1"]
  n_pred      <- ncol(data_train) - 1

  if (is.null(mtry_range)) {
    mtry_range <- seq(2, floor(sqrt(n_pred)), by = 1)
  }

  set.seed(123)
  group_folds <- groupKFold(patient_ids, k = k_folds)

  train_f1 <- unique(patient_ids[group_folds[[1]]])
  test_f1  <- unique(patient_ids)[!unique(patient_ids) %in% train_f1]
  cat(sprintf(
    "Fold 1 leakage check - Train: %d | Test: %d | Overlap: %d\n",
    length(train_f1), length(test_f1),
    length(intersect(train_f1, test_f1))
  ))

  ctrl <- trainControl(
    method          = "cv",
    index           = group_folds,
    classProbs      = TRUE,
    savePredictions = "final",
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    verboseIter     = FALSE
  )

  set.seed(123)
  tuned <- tryCatch(
    train(
      Visit ~ .,
      data       = data_train,
      method     = "rf",
      trControl  = ctrl,
      tuneGrid   = expand.grid(mtry = mtry_range),
      ntree      = ntree,
      metric     = "ROC",
      importance = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("Tuning failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )

  if (is.null(tuned)) stop("RF tuning failed.")

  best_mtry <- tuned$bestTune$mtry
  cat(sprintf("Best mtry: %d\n", best_mtry))
  print(tuned)

  best_mtry
}
```

`bag_rf`: paired patient-level bootstrap RF. For each iteration, patients are
sampled with replacement and both visits for each sampled patient are included.
Importance scores are averaged and SD computed across all valid iterations.

```{r}
bag_rf <- function(prep, best_mtry, config) {
  data   <- prep$data
  n_bags <- config$n_bags
  ntree  <- config$ntree

  patient_ids <- unique(data$ID1)
  n_patients  <- length(patient_ids)
  imp_list    <- vector("list", n_bags)

  set.seed(123)
  for (b in seq_len(n_bags)) {
    sampled <- sample(patient_ids, n_patients, replace = TRUE)

    boot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sampled, function(p) {
      data[data$ID1 == p, ]
    }))

    train_data       <- boot_data[, !names(boot_data) %in% "ID1"]
    train_data$Visit <- droplevels(train_data$Visit)

    rf <- tryCatch(
      randomForest(
        Visit ~ .,
        data       = train_data,
        ntree      = ntree,
        mtry       = best_mtry,
        importance = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(rf)) {
      imp_list[[b]] <- importance(rf, type = 1, scale = TRUE)[, "MeanDecreaseAccuracy"]
    }
  }

  imp_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_list)
  n_valid  <- length(imp_list)
  imp_mat  <- do.call(cbind, imp_list)

  cat(sprintf("Valid bags: %d / %d\n", n_valid, n_bags))

  list(
    avg_importance = rowMeans(imp_mat),
    sd_importance  = apply(imp_mat, 1, sd),
    n_valid_bags   = n_valid
  )
}
```

`plot_importance_fig`: dot plot of the top features ranked by average MDA.
Features above the random threshold are shown in dark red. Rendered inline
and saved to file.

```{r}
plot_importance_fig <- function(importance_vals,
                                rand_threshold,
                                title     = "Variable importance",
                                save_path = NULL,
                                filename  = "importance.png",
                                top_n     = 75) {

  sorted_vals <- sort(importance_vals, decreasing = TRUE)
  n_show      <- min(top_n, length(sorted_vals))
  top_vals    <- sorted_vals[seq_len(n_show)]
  y_pos       <- n_show:1
  dot_colors  <- ifelse(top_vals > rand_threshold, "darkred", "gray60")
  n_sig       <- sum(
    importance_vals[!grepl("^Random_", names(importance_vals))] > rand_threshold
  )

  draw_plot <- function() {
    par(mar = c(5, 12, 4, 2))

    x_min <- min(top_vals) * ifelse(min(top_vals) < 0, 1.1, 0.9)
    x_max <- max(top_vals) * 1.2

    plot(top_vals, y_pos,
         type = "n", xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
         yaxt = "n", xaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Mean Decrease in Accuracy", ylab = "", main = title)

    axis(1, at = seq(floor(min(top_vals)), ceiling(max(top_vals)),
                     by = max(0.5, round(ceiling(max(top_vals)) / 5, 1))))
    abline(h = y_pos, lty = "dotted", col = "gray80")
    points(top_vals, y_pos, pch = 16, cex = 1.2, col = dot_colors)
    text(par("usr")[1], y_pos, labels = names(top_vals),
         pos = 2, xpd = TRUE, col = "black", cex = 0.9)
    abline(v = rand_threshold, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

    usr <- par("usr")
    text(usr[2] - (usr[2] - usr[1]) * 0.02,
         usr[3] + (usr[4] - usr[3]) * 0.05,
         labels = paste("Random threshold:", round(rand_threshold, 3)),
         adj = c(1, 0), cex = 1, col = "gray40")
    mtext(paste(n_sig, "cytokines above random threshold"),
          side = 3, line = 0.5, cex = 0.8)
  }

  draw_plot()

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    png(file.path(save_path, filename), width = 2600, height = 4500, res = 300)
    draw_plot()
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", filename))
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

`run_roc`: paired patient-level bootstrap ROC. week 0 is always the reference
class (first level of the Visit factor).

```{r}
run_roc <- function(data, cytokine, n_bootstrap = 2000) {
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- roc(
      response  = data$Visit == levels(data$Visit)[1],
      predictor = data[[cytokine]],
      direction = "<",
      quiet     = TRUE
    )

    patient_ids <- unique(data$ID1)
    n_patients  <- length(patient_ids)
    boot_aucs   <- numeric(n_bootstrap)

    for (b in seq_len(n_bootstrap)) {
      sampled   <- sample(patient_ids, n_patients, replace = TRUE)
      boot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sampled, function(p) data[data$ID1 == p, ]))

      boot_roc <- tryCatch(
        roc(boot_data$Visit == levels(data$Visit)[1], boot_data[[cytokine]],
            quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      boot_aucs[b] <- if (!is.null(boot_roc)) as.numeric(auc(boot_roc)) else NA
    }

    boot_aucs <- boot_aucs[!is.na(boot_aucs)]

    list(
      roc          = roc_obj,
      auc          = auc(roc_obj),
      ci_lower     = quantile(boot_aucs, 0.025),
      ci_upper     = quantile(boot_aucs, 0.975),
      n_valid_boot = length(boot_aucs)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("ROC failed for ", cytokine, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}
```

`plot_roc_curves`: ROC curves for a named list of cytokines with AUC and CI
in the legend. Rendered inline and saved to file.

```{r}
plot_roc_curves <- function(roc_results,
                             title     = "ROC curves",
                             save_path = NULL,
                             filename  = "roc.png") {

  colors <- c("#000000", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3")

  draw_plot <- function() {
    par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
    plot(roc_results[[1]]$roc,
         col = colors[1], main = title,
         xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
         lwd = 2, cex.main = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.1, cex.axis = 1.0,
         legacy.axes = TRUE)

    if (length(roc_results) > 1) {
      for (i in seq(2, length(roc_results))) {
        plot(roc_results[[i]]$roc, col = colors[i], add = TRUE, lwd = 2)
      }
    }

    grid()

    legend("bottomright",
           legend = sapply(names(roc_results), function(cyt) {
             r <- roc_results[[cyt]]
             sprintf("%s  AUC = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f - %.2f)",
                     cyt, as.numeric(r$auc), r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper)
           }),
           col = colors[seq_along(roc_results)],
           lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.9, bg = "white", box.lwd = 1)
  }

  draw_plot()

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    png(file.path(save_path, filename), width = 1800, height = 2000,
        res = 300, bg = "white")
    draw_plot()
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", filename))
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

`build_summary`: summary table with AUC, bootstrap CI, and optimal threshold
metrics (Youden index).

```{r}
build_summary <- function(roc_results) {
  get_coords <- function(roc_obj) {
    opt <- coords(roc_obj, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                  ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"),
                  transpose = FALSE)
    if (nrow(opt) > 1) opt <- opt[which.max(opt$sensitivity), ]
    opt
  }

  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(roc_results), function(cyt) {
    r   <- roc_results[[cyt]]
    opt <- tryCatch(get_coords(r$roc), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(opt)) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      Biomarker         = cyt,
      AUC               = round(as.numeric(r$auc), 3),
      CI_Lower          = round(r$ci_lower, 3),
      CI_Upper          = round(r$ci_upper, 3),
      Optimal_Threshold = round(opt$threshold, 4),
      Sensitivity_pct   = round(opt$sensitivity * 100, 1),
      Specificity_pct   = round(opt$specificity * 100, 1),
      PPV_pct           = round(opt$ppv * 100, 1),
      NPV_pct           = round(opt$npv * 100, 1),
      Youden_J          = round(opt$sensitivity + opt$specificity - 1, 3),
      N_Bootstrap       = r$n_valid_boot,
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    )
  }))
}
```

# week 0 vs week 16

```{r}
prep_16 <- prepare_rf_data(protein_log_wide, rf_config$W0_W16)
mtry_16 <- tune_rf(prep_16, rf_config$W0_W16)
bag_16  <- bag_rf(prep_16, mtry_16, rf_config$W0_W16)
```

```{r}
avg_imp_16   <- bag_16$avg_importance
is_rand_16   <- grepl("^Random_", names(avg_imp_16))
threshold_16 <- mean(avg_imp_16[is_rand_16])
cyt_mda_16   <- avg_imp_16[!is_rand_16]
sig_16       <- sort(cyt_mda_16[cyt_mda_16 > threshold_16], decreasing = TRUE)
top_cyts_16  <- names(head(sig_16, rf_config$W0_W16$top_n_cytokines))

cat(sprintf(
  "Threshold: %.3f | Cytokines above threshold: %d | Top %d: %s\n",
  threshold_16, length(sig_16), length(top_cyts_16),
  paste(top_cyts_16, collapse = ", ")
))
print(sig_16)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 14

plot_importance_fig(
  importance_vals = avg_imp_16,
  rand_threshold  = threshold_16,
  title           = "Variable importance: week 0 vs week 16",
  save_path       = output_fig2a_s4a,
  filename        = "S4A_importance_W0_W16.png"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
roc_16 <- list()
for (cyt in top_cyts_16) {
  cat(sprintf("ROC: %s\n", cyt))
  roc_16[[cyt]] <- run_roc(
    data        = prep_16$data,
    cytokine    = cyt,
    n_bootstrap = rf_config$W0_W16$n_bootstrap_roc
  )
}
roc_16 <- Filter(Negate(is.null), roc_16)

for (cyt in names(roc_16)) {
  r <- roc_16[[cyt]]
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s AUC: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f) | Bootstrap n: %d\n",
              cyt, as.numeric(r$auc), r$ci_lower, r$ci_upper, r$n_valid_boot))
}
```

```{r}
plot_roc_curves(
  roc_results = roc_16,
  title       = "ROC curves: week 0 vs week 16",
  save_path   = output_fig2a_s4a,
  filename    = "2A_ROC_W0_W16.png"
)
```

```{r}
summary_16 <- build_summary(roc_16)
print(summary_16)

write_xlsx(summary_16, file.path(output_fig2a_s4a, "ROC_summary_W0_W16.xlsx"))
```
